StaticPages.aboutBody: neop is a marketplace for tickets to the world's best live events — concerts, festivals, sports, and theatre. We work only with verified sellers, and every order is covered by our 100% guarantee.
StaticPages.partnersBody: We work with a global network of verified sellers, venues, and event organisers to bring reliable ticket inventory to fans everywhere. Interested in partnering with us? Get in touch at <email>contact@neop.events</email>.
StaticPages.helpBody: Looking for your tickets? They're sent to your confirmation email and land in your mobile wallet shortly after checkout. For anything else, our team is one email away at <email>contact@neop.events</email>.
StaticPages.faqA1: Yes. Every order is covered by neop's 100% guarantee — if an event is cancelled or your tickets don't arrive, you get a full refund.
StaticPages.faqQ2: How do I receive my tickets?
StaticPages.faqA2: Tickets are delivered to your mobile wallet shortly after checkout, ready to scan at the door.
StaticPages.faqQ3: Who do I contact for help?
StaticPages.faqA3: Email us any time at <email>contact@neop.events</email> — we're happy to help.
StaticPages.privacyBody: We collect only the information needed to process your bookings, keep your account secure, and improve neop. We never sell your personal data. Questions about your data? Write to <email>contact@neop.events</email>.
StaticPages.termsBody: By using neop you agree to book events in good faith and to provide accurate details at checkout. Ticket sales are final except where covered by our 100% guarantee. Questions? Email <email>contact@neop.events</email>.
StaticPages.cookiesBody: We use cookies to keep you signed in, remember your language and currency, and understand how neop is used. You can manage cookies at any time in your browser settings.
StaticPages.sitemapIntro: A quick map of neop — jump straight to any section.

About.metaDescription: See how neop works: search and compare tickets in 14 languages, a verified ticketing partner, and a 100% guarantee on every order.
About.schemaDescription: neop is a discovery and comparison platform for tickets to concerts, festivals, sports events, theatre and comedy shows worldwide, available in 14 languages. Every order is covered by a 100% guarantee, with payment and ticket delivery handled by a verified ticketing partner.
About.missionBody: neop exists to make finding tickets around the world simple. We bring together concerts, festivals, sports events, theatre and comedy shows held in many countries, shown in your language and currency, in one place. Our goal is simple: help you compare the options and find the right seat, at the right price, without wasting time.
About.howStep1Body: Browse our catalogue of events by city, artist, team, or date. Results are shown in your language, with prices in your currency, so you can compare quickly and easily.
About.howStep2Body: Compare the available ticket categories, check the seating plan when one is provided, and choose the offer that fits your budget and seating preferences.
About.howStep3Body: You're redirected to Gigsberg, our verified ticketing partner, to pay securely and receive your ticket.
About.howNote: This redirect isn't a drawback — it's a deliberate way of splitting the work. neop focuses on what it does best: searching and comparing events worldwide. Our ticketing partner focuses on what it does best: securing your payment and delivering a valid ticket. This split lets you benefit from both a strong international search engine and a specialised, proven ticketing service.
About.guaranteeIntro: Every order placed through neop is covered by our 100% guarantee. It applies in three situations:
About.guaranteeItem1: An invalid ticket or one refused at the door — you're fully refunded, or offered an equivalent replacement ticket.
About.guaranteeItem2: An event cancelled with no replacement — the amount you paid is fully refunded.
About.guaranteeItem3: An event postponed — your ticket stays valid for the new date, or you can request a refund if the new date doesn't work for you.
About.guaranteeHow: To claim the guarantee, contact us at <email>contact@neop.events</email> with your order number and a description of the issue. We acknowledge every request within 48 business hours and process refunds or replacements within 14 days of your case being confirmed. This guarantee costs you nothing extra and applies to every order, whatever its amount.
About.securityBody: Payment and ticket delivery are handled by Gigsberg, our verified ticketing partner. Your banking and personal data only ever passes through its secure, encrypted infrastructure — neop never collects or stores payment information on its own servers. We work exclusively with verified ticketing partners, chosen for their reliability and adherence to industry security standards. The neop.events website itself is also served entirely over an encrypted (HTTPS) connection.
About.languagesBody: neop is available in 14 languages and gives access to events held in many countries, from a concert in Paris to a match in Madrid to a festival in Berlin. Wherever you are and whatever language you speak, you can search, compare, and book with ease.
About.contactBody: Have a question, an issue with an order, or a suggestion? Write to us at <email>contact@neop.events</email> — we reply to every message.
About.legalBody: The neop.events website is published under the name neop. For any question about the site or your rights, contact us at <email>contact@neop.events</email>.
